I changed the title-page date in `coastal-survey` from "November 2026" to "December 2026" and compiled it. **The PDF is 2 pages.** The compile had 0 warnings and took 12.68 s.

The title page shows "December 2026". Page 1 has the title page and the three sections, and page 2 has the references.

- **Wrong project first:** the tab I was given had a different project open, "A space for your next great idea". I switched to `coastal-survey` from the project list. I didn't change anything in the other project.
- **Undone overwrite:** my first edit replaced the whole contents of `main.tex` with one line. I undid it right away with Ctrl+Z, and all 16 lines came back unchanged. I then edited only the date text. The final file has the same lines as before, with only the date changed.
